# Media Automation Lark

> Local-first Feishu/Lark content automation Agent Skill and CLI toolkit for creators and small teams. It collects RSS/API feeds, public web pages, local files, and platform metrics into previewable Markdown, JSON backups, HTML dashboards, and optional reviewed Feishu/Lark records.

This Pages entry describes the open-source repository. It is not a hosted publishing platform. The project does not bypass logins, captchas, paywalls, or platform controls. Public collection must follow applicable law, platform terms, rate limits, and robots.txt.

## Supported workflows

- RSS/API content archiving to local previews and optional Feishu/Lark Bitable records.
- Public web search collection and categorization into Markdown.
- Articles, images, PDFs, and Office files converted into a local Markdown material archive.
- Platform metrics collected into local HTML and Excel dashboards, with optional Feishu/Lark sync.
- Local control-panel previews and operating-system scheduling templates.

## Operational boundaries

- Start with `--offline-demo` for the built-in no-network search fixture, then use `--dry-run` before any remote write.
- Feishu/Lark writes and bot notifications require explicit user confirmation and local credentials.
- The project is not a resident scheduler and does not claim complete platform coverage or complete SSRF protection.
- Search ranking, indexing, traffic, downloads, and AI citations are not implied by repository metadata or this file.
